objective: Add a deterministic regression test proving that runMission stops contracting later inference waves as soon as minVerifiedCandidates is satisfied. The test must use an injected dispatch function, produce one verification-passing edit, configure more maximum rounds than are needed, and assert the actual wave count or dispatch count so unnecessary future inference spending is detected.
constraints: Change tests only; the early-quorum implementation already exists.
Do not weaken or remove existing assertions.
Keep the test deterministic and provider-free by using an injected dispatch function.
Assert that no inference wave after the first verified candidate is dispatched.
